title: Just Juice Desserts Banoffee Pie 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Desserts Banoffee Pie is a faithful recreation of the beloved British pudding. It features the creamy, fruity taste of ripe Banana layered with rich, sticky Toffee. The profile is rounded off with notes of fresh Whipped Cream and a buttery Pastry crust, creating a full-bodied dessert vape. The distinct layers of fruit, confectionery, and bakery flavours make this a complex and satisfying option for dessert lovers. Uniquely formulated with a 60PG/40VG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed to deliver exceptional flavour clarity and a discreet amount of vapour. This higher PG content makes it ideal for use with low-powered pod vape kits and starter devices, where it ensures efficient wicking and consistent performance. The premium nicotine salt formula provides a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction, even at the higher 20mg strength. For the best experience, we recommend using this e-liquid with coils or pods rated between 0.8ohm and 1.2ohm. The Desserts collection by Just Juice represents a shift from their signature fruity and ice-infused blends, focusing instead on comforting, bakery-inspired profiles. Expertly crafted in the UK, this range is designed to offer depth, balance, and smooth satisfaction for vapers seeking a richer taste experience. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, Just Juice Desserts provide a versatile option for adult smokers and vapers alike.
